▌ Orders with a 25% discount come out wrong. Fix it, with a test.
√ $ finding other uses · grep -rn discount acme
◟ $ running the test suite · python3 -m unittest discover tests; sleep 60
Before running the suite, make sure nothing else reads discount as a flat amount; then the
tests should confirm a 25% discount on 40.00 now totals 30.00.
Find where the discount is applied
Apply the discount as a percentage
